description: Open a browser window on the user's computer for them to sign in to Overleaf, and save the session, as the login command does. Call it only when the user agrees. A session that already works is returned at once and nothing opens. It waits up to 40 seconds: status waiting means the user is still signing in, so call it again only after they say they have finished. After a failure, ask the user before calling it again. Needs Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, or Microsoft Edge.
name: sign_in
